# Dhiraj KC

> A portfolio that brings together technical delivery, design execution, research support, and operational leadership in one clear narrative.

My recent work spans web platforms, event production, social media systems, and technical coordination. This site is designed to show how those threads connect rather than present them as isolated roles.

This `llms.txt` file is generated from the portfolio content files during local development and production builds.
Detailed markdown mirrors of page content are not currently published on this site, so the links below point to the canonical HTML pages.

## Site

- [Home](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/): I build and support digital products, communication systems, and operational structures for organizations and technical communities.
- [Projects](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/): Portfolio case studies across engineering, design, research, and leadership work.
- [Experience](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/experience/): Role history grouped by organization or by role.
- [Contact](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/contact/): Contact information and profile links.

## Featured Projects

- [Agrineer Volume 8 Layout Design](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/agrineer-layout-design/): Designed the editorial layout for Agrineer Volume 8 with a focus on readability, pacing, and polished print presentation.
- [Digital Nomad Tax Freedom Index 2025](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/digital-nomad-tax-freedom-index-2025/): Supported comparative research for Liberty International's 2025 digital nomad policy index by compiling tax, visa, and residency indicators across countries.
- [ICRTAI 2025 Conference Visual and AV Production](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/icrtai-2025-conference-visual-av/): Led visual design and live AV execution for a large hybrid AI conference, supporting stage content, branding materials, and real-time session delivery.
- [Soccer Match Highlights Event Extraction](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/soccer-match-highlights-event-extraction/): Built a multimodal AI pipeline that detects key match events and generates structured highlight outputs from full-length football videos.
- [X-Hack 3.0 AI Hackathon](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/x-hack-3-ai-hackathon/): Helped coordinate CS50 AI Inspired X-Hack 3.0, a national hackathon focused on AI-driven business and social innovation.
- [Youth Activism Nepal (Website)](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/youth-activism-nepal-platform/): Built and maintain a custom web platform while owning hosting, deployment, and the surrounding operational infrastructure.
- [CS50 AI Nepal Classes and Program](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/cs50x-nepal-program-delivery/): Helped plan and deliver Nepal's first large-scale CS50 AI program, combining technical instruction, curriculum execution, and a structured public-facing learning journey.
